ratings.why: Only number literals that JSON.parse itself cannot tell from integers are affected, so catching them would need a custom number parser that no real client of this small service needs.
It needs two server processes on one data file, which the request never asks for and the notes rule out, while concurrency within one process is kept safe as asked.
Dot-segment, lone-surrogate and 16,000-character group IDs are odd edge inputs that no real caller would send, and refusing them is a matter of taste.
Using a symlink for a data file is an ordinary operator setup, and resolving the link before the atomic replace is a cheap fix that stops the real ledger from going stale without notice.
